verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no throttling, concurrency limits, or rate-limited execution queues for Windmill workflows. Step retries with a delay (windmill-docs-13) and cron-based schedules (windmill-docs-18) are adjacent features: one handles errors, the other is a recurring schedule. Neither caps execution rate to respect downstream limits, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can throttle or queue workflow executions to respect downstream rate limits
